spans.s:
भज् {vI.v} {c1c} U. (भजति-ते) but usually
Atm. only; बभाज, भेजे, अभाक्षीत्, अभक्त,
भक्ष्याति-ते, भक्त)
1 (a) To share,
distribute, divide; भजेरन् पैतृकं रिक्थं

; न तत्पुत्रैर्मजेत्सार्धं 209,
119. (b) To assign, allot,
apportion; गायत्रीमग्नयेऽभजत् Ait. Br.
--2
To obtain for oneself, share in,
partake of; पित्र्यं वा भजते शीलं

.
--4 (a) To resort to, betake
oneself to, have recourse to;
शिलातलं भेजे

. (b) To practise, follow,
observe; भेजे धर्ममनातुरः

.
--5 To enjoy, possess,
have, suffer, experience, entertain;
विधुरपि भजतेतरां कलंकं

.
--7 To
adore, honour, worship (as a god).
--8 To choose, select, perfer,
accept; संतः परीक्ष्यान्यतरद्भजंते

.
--10 To be attached or devoted to;

.
--11 To take possession
of.
--12 To fall to the lot of any
one.
--13 To grant, bestow.
--14 To
supply, furnish (Ved.).
--15 To
favour.
--16 To decide in favour of,
declare for.
--17 To love, court
(affection).
--18 To apply oneself
to, be engaged in.
--19 To cook,
dress (food).
--20 To employ,
engage. (The meanings of this root
are variously modified according to
the noun with which it is
connected: --e. g. निद्रां भज् to go to sleep;
मूर्छां भज् to swoon; भावं भज् to
show love for &c. &c.). --

To divide.
--2 To put to flight,
[]
pursue.
--3 To cook, dress. {vII.v} {c10c} U.
(भाजयति-ते), regarded by some as
the caus. of भज् I
1 To cook.
--2 To
give.

भाज् {c10c} U. To divide,
distribute; see भज् caus.

भाज् a. (Usually at the end of
comp.)
1 Sharing or participating
in, liable to; पाप˚

; दोष˚
guilty.
--2 Having, enjoying,
possessing, obtaining; सुख˚, रिक्थ˚.
--3
Entitled to.
--4 Feeling,
experiencing, being sensible of.
--5 Devoting
oneself to.
--6 Living in, inhabiting,
dwelling in; as in कुहरभाज्, दरीभाज्
&c.
--7 Going or resorting to, seeking.
--8 Worshipping.
--9 Falling to the
lot of.
--10 What must be done, a
duty (कर्तव्य);

भजकः [भज्-ण्वुल्]
1 A divider,
distributer.
--2 A worshipper, votary,
devotee.

भजनं [भज्-ल्युट्]
1 Sharing,
dividing.
--2 Possession.
--3 Service,
adoration, worship
--4 Waiting or
attending upon.

भाजनं [भाज्येतऽनेन भाज्-ल्युट्]
1
Sharing, dividing.
--2 Division. (in
arith.).
--3 A vessel, pot, cup, plate;
पुष्पभाजनं Ś. 4;

.
--4 (Fig.)
A receptacle, recipient, repository;
स श्रियो भाजनं नरः

.
--5 A fit or
deserving person, a fit object or
person; भवादृशा एव भवंति
भाजनान्युपदेशानां

.
--6 Representation.
--7 A measure equal to 64 palas.

भजमान a.
1 Dividing.
--2
Enjoying.
--3 Fit, right, proper.

भाजित a. Shared, divided.
--तं A
share, portion.

भाज्य a. [भज्-ण्यत्] Divisible.
--ज्यं
1 A portion, share.
--2 An
inheritance.
--3 (In arith.) The
dividend.
